package.json:
{
  "name": "solanaut",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "description": "A transaction firewall for Solana AI agents. See README.md; the MVP baseline is docs/SPEC.md.",
  "workspaces": [
    "packages/*",
    "apps/*"
  ],
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22.6"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "doctor": "uv run --script tools/doctor.py",
    "test": "node --test packages/sdk/test/*.test.ts apps/*/test/*.test.ts evals/ci/*.test.ts",
    "typecheck": "tsc -p tsconfig.json",
    "sandbox": "node apps/sandbox/src/main.ts",
    "validator": "PATH=\"$HOME/.local/share/solana/install/active_release/bin:$PATH\" solana-test-validator --ledger .sandbox/ledger --reset --quiet",
    "pin-table": "node packages/sdk/bin/pin-table.ts",
    "replay": "node packages/sdk/bin/replay.ts",
    "verify-archive": "node packages/sdk/bin/verify-archive.ts",
    "prepare-policy": "node packages/sdk/bin/prepare-policy.ts",
    "release:prepare": "node packages/sdk/bin/prepare-release.ts",
    "test:package": "node --test evals/packaging/*.test.ts",
    "test:package:faults": "node evals/packaging/faults.ts",
    "test:latch:faults": "node evals/ci/latch-faults.ts",
    "test:bite": "node evals/ci/bite.ts",
    "test:fuzz": "node evals/ci/fuzz.ts",
    "test:replay": "node evals/ci/replay.ts",
    "test:kills": "node evals/ci/kills.ts",
    "test:coverage": "node evals/ci/coverage-run.ts",
    "test:mutation": "node evals/ci/mutation-run.ts",
    "test:differential": "node evals/ci/differential-run.ts",
    "test:traffic": "node evals/ci/traffic-run.ts",
    "cockpit": "node apps/cockpit/src/server.ts"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@stryker-mutator/core": "10.0.0",
    "@types/node": "26.6.3",
    "fast-check": "4.10.2",
    "istanbul-lib-coverage": "3.2.2",
    "istanbul-lib-instrument": "6.0.3",
    "puppeteer-core": "25.12.0",
    "typescript": "7.0.2"
  }
}
stryker.config.json:
{
  "mutate": [
    "packages/sdk/src/base58.ts",
    "packages/sdk/src/classify.ts",
    "packages/sdk/src/guard.ts",
    "packages/sdk/src/message.ts",
    "packages/sdk/src/pda.ts",
    "packages/sdk/src/policy.ts",
    "packages/sdk/src/state.ts",
    "packages/sdk/src/tables.ts"
  ],
  "testRunner": "command",
  "commandRunner": {
    "command": "node --test --test-isolation=none packages/sdk/test/adapters.test.ts packages/sdk/test/admission.test.ts packages/sdk/test/boundary-validation.test.ts packages/sdk/test/classify.test.ts packages/sdk/test/decode.test.ts packages/sdk/test/drain.battery.test.ts packages/sdk/test/durable.test.ts packages/sdk/test/inspect.test.ts packages/sdk/test/keel.test.ts packages/sdk/test/latch-c.test.ts packages/sdk/test/ownership.test.ts packages/sdk/test/pin-table.test.ts packages/sdk/test/policy.test.ts packages/sdk/test/request-identity.test.ts packages/sdk/test/sensor.battery.test.ts packages/sdk/test/signed-policy.test.ts packages/sdk/test/signing-history.test.ts packages/sdk/test/storage-failures.test.ts"
  },
  "coverageAnalysis": "off",
  "concurrency": 4,
  "timeoutMS": 10000,
  "timeoutFactor": 1.5,
  "reporters": [
    "clear-text",
    "progress-append-only",
    "json"
  ],
  "jsonReporter": {
    "fileName": "reports/mutation.json"
  },
  "thresholds": {
    "high": 80,
    "low": 80,
    "break": 80
  },
  "ignoreStatic": false,
  "inPlace": false,
  "tempDirName": ".stryker-tmp",
  "cleanTempDir": false,
  "allowConsoleColors": false
}
